card.name: Inside words starting with oct
card.fires_on: The piece "oct" or "ct" inside words that begin with oct or contain octyl, such as octreotide, octane, dioctyl and trioctyl. It also fires on "CT" in OCT2.

modes.label: Octyl and octane words
modes.description: The ct piece inside chemical names like dioctyl, trioctyl, or octane.

modes.label: Other oct words
modes.description: The oct piece in other words or abbreviations, such as Octave or OCT2.

card.writes: No clear meaning; the promoted tokens are mixed foreign-script pieces and the suppressed ones are unrelated word pieces.
